mapper.sql: g.group_key, v.option_value, v.label_zh, v.label_fr, v.label_en, v.requires_extra_text, v.status, g.status as group_status
mapper.select:
select
from cm_option_values v inner join cm_option_groups g on g.id = v.group_id where g.manage_status = 'dynamic' and g.status = 'enabled' and v.status = 'enabled' order by g.sort_order, g.group_key, v.sort_order, v.option_value

select
from cm_option_values v inner join cm_option_groups g on g.id = v.group_id where g.manage_status = 'dynamic' order by g.sort_order, g.group_key, v.sort_order, v.option_value

select coalesce(date_format(max(updated_at), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), 'empty') from ( select updated_at from cm_option_groups where manage_status = 'dynamic' union all select v.updated_at from cm_option_values v inner join cm_option_groups g on g.id = v.group_id where g.manage_status = 'dynamic' ) t

select id, group_key as groupKey, group_name as groupName, group_scope as groupScope, manage_status as manageStatus, sort_order as sortOrder, status, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_option_groups where manage_status = 'dynamic' order by sort_order, group_key

select v.id, g.group_key as groupKey, g.group_name as groupName, v.option_value as optionValue, v.label_zh as labelZh, v.label_fr as labelFr, v.label_en as labelEn, v.sort_order as sortOrder, v.requires_extra_text as requiresExtraText, v.status, v.created_at as createdAt, v.updated_at as updatedAt from cm_option_values v inner join cm_option_groups g on g.id = v.group_id where g.manage_status = 'dynamic' and v.id = #{id} limit 1

select id, group_key as groupKey, group_name as groupName, group_scope as groupScope, manage_status as manageStatus, sort_order as sortOrder, status, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_option_groups where manage_status = 'dynamic' and group_key = #{groupKey} limit 1

select v.id, g.group_key as groupKey, g.group_name as groupName, v.option_value as optionValue, v.label_zh as labelZh, v.label_fr as labelFr, v.label_en as labelEn, v.sort_order as sortOrder, v.requires_extra_text as requiresExtraText, v.status, v.created_at as createdAt, v.updated_at as updatedAt from cm_option_values v inner join cm_option_groups g on g.id = v.group_id where g.manage_status = 'dynamic' and g.group_key = #{groupKey} and v.option_value = #{optionValue} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cm_option_values ( id, group_id, option_value, label_zh, label_fr, label_en, sort_order, requires_extra_text, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{groupId}, #{optionValue}, #{labelZh}, #{labelFr}, #{labelEn}, #{sortOrder}, #{requiresExtraText}, #{status}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp )
mapper.update:
update cm_option_values
label_zh = #{labelZh}, label_fr = #{labelFr}, label_en = #{labelEn}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, requires_extra_text = #{requiresExtraText}, status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp
where id = #{id} and exists ( select 1 from cm_option_groups g where g.id = cm_option_values.group_id and g.manage_status = 'dynamic' )
mapper.insert: insert into cm_audit_logs ( id, actor_type, actor_user_id, subject_type, subject_id, action, before_data, after_data, reason, created_at ) values ( #{id}, #{actorType}, #{actorUserId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{action}, #{beforeData}, #{afterData}, #{reason}, current_timestamp )
